authChainNone: No level above carries auth: the request goes out without it.
binaryFileHelp: Relative to the root of the workspace.
binaryFileRefused: The path stays inside the workspace: relative, with «/» and no way out.
bodyEmpty: The server answered without a body.
bodyTooBig: Too large to lay out: shown as it came.
destinationMoved: A script changed the destination: it left without secrets
destinationMovedHint: Put the host in the environment and the secrets go along.
redirectHeld: Redirect stopped: it carried a secret to another site
codeCopyFailed: The code could not be copied
codeLeftOutFile: The body file {{file}} is not in the code: add it by hand.
codeRedacted: Secret variables show as [redacted]. Put them back where you paste it.
cookiesEmpty: This response did not set any.

curlInvalid.notCurl: The pasted text is not a curl command.
curlInvalid.noUrl: The curl command has no URL.
curlInvalid.syntax: The curl command cannot be read as shell text.

curlNotice.dataFile: The body file {{subject}} cannot be read from here; it is left out.
curlNotice.dataFileCopy: The body is the file {{subject}}: copy it to the root of the workspace.
curlNotice.formFilePath: The file of the field {{subject}} has no usable path; the field is left out.
curlNotice.formFileCopy: The form sends the file {{subject}}: copy it to the root of the workspace.
curlNotice.formFileContent: The field {{subject}} reads its text from a file; it is left out.
curlNotice.cookieFile: The cookie file {{subject}} is not read.
curlNotice.headerFile: The header file {{subject}} is not read.
curlNotice.unsupportedOption: The option {{subject}} has no equivalent in Mandor and is ignored.
curlNotice.unknownOption: The option {{subject}} is not known and is ignored.
curlNotice.extraUrl: Only the first URL is kept; {{subject}} is ignored.
curlNotice.moreCommands: Only the first command is read.
curlNotice.mixedBody: The command has a form and data; the form is kept.
curlNotice.settingOutOfRange: The value of {{subject}} is out of range and is ignored.

defaultsHelp: What every request does while its own settings say nothing else. A request that changes one keeps that one, and only that one.
exampleLocked: Method and URL are edited in {{request}}
exampleUncheckedHint: Send the request to compare what the API answers with this example.
exampleNoDifferencesHint: Send again to look for new changes.
exampleAccepted: Example updated with the received response
exampleNoSchemaHint: It is generated from the expected body: the types and fields that must arrive.
exampleSchemaNotJson: The expected body is not JSON
followRedirectsHelp: A 3xx response is followed to where it points.
graphqlSplit: Resize the query and the variables
headerAutoAuth: The authorization this request goes by
headerAutoContentType: The type of the body, set on the Body tab
headerAutoCacheControl: The response is read alive, not from a cache
headerAutoContentLength: The layer that dials weighs the body
headerAutoConnection: The connection is reused between requests
headerAutoHost: The layer that dials works it out from the address
httpVersionHelp: Auto lets the server choose HTTP/2 or HTTP/1.1 as the connection opens. Held to one, the send fails when the server does not speak it.
keepMethodOnRedirect: Keep the method on a redirect
keepMethodOnRedirectHelp: A 301 or 302 repeats the method and the body instead of turning a POST into a GET. A 303 is always a GET.
maxRedirectsHelp: Past the ceiling the send fails. Zero follows none.
resizeSplit: Resize the request and its response
responseIdle: Send the request to see its response here.
scriptsSwitchedOff_one: Scripts are off: {{count}} did not run
scriptsSwitchedOff_other: Scripts are off: {{count}} did not run
timeoutHelp: How long the send waits for the whole response before it gives up.
timingsViaProxy: Sent through a proxy: the phases could not be measured.
tlsOffHelp: The send trusts any certificate the server shows.
useCookieJarHelp: The cookies of the jar for the address go out, and the ones the response sets are kept.
validateTlsHelp: A certificate that does not verify stops the send.
previewNotJson: The body is not valid JSON. Pick a format to read it as it came.
followAuthorizationOnRedirect: Keep the authorization on another host
followAuthorizationOnRedirectHelp: A redirect to another host still carries the Authorization header. Cookies never cross.
maxResponseSizeHelp: Past this size the send stops and nothing is shown. 0 downloads whatever comes.
tlsMaxVersionHelp: The handshake offers nothing newer: a way to try a server as an older client would.
tlsCiphersHelp: Separated by colons, with the names OpenSSL gives them. Empty offers the usual ones.
